name: ur5e_muse
notes: UR5e arm has 6 arm actuators and no gripper, only attachment_site on wrist_3_link, so attach Robotiq 2F-85 tool at that site with pos 0 0 0 quat 1 0 0 0. ee_site tool/pinch and gripper tool/fingers_actuator per tool list with prefix tool/. Open 0=85mm, closed 255 per tool doc, both inside ctrlrange. Approach +z because tool fingers point along its own +z (palm to tip). Closing guessed +y (parallel jaw closure perpendicular to +z); unsure between +x/+y without seeing 2f85.xml pinch orientation - to be confirmed by test. Home keyframe 'home' used as start, assumed hand above table. base 0,0,0 on table, yaw 0 to face +x objects, fixed_base true to weld arm, active null for arm.
